messages:
Alex R.: Morning triage — quick snapshot: incoming ~28 tickets since 0100 UTC, ~6 P2s. Primary blips:

Alex R.: 1) Embedding job for user-import failing on timeout (S3 read retries). Seen in 3 customers. Root cause suspected: intermittent S3 5xx from eu-west-1. Workaround: bump retries to 6, fallback to smaller batch size.

Maria T.: Filed a support ticket to infra (INC-4228) and added a temporary macro. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4228

Sam K.: Can you drop that macro sample here so I can review it? I'll attempt a quick rollback if it keeps happening.

Alex R.: Paste of macro change I used:
```
// TEMP: increase s3 retries
macro: retry_s3_reads
body: "retry=6; backoff=exp(100,2); batch_size=50"
```

Kevin L.: :eyes: I'll queue a small Dedicated capacity bump for the affected customers but prefer to keep cost low. If this repeats we should route to fallback model variant.

Maria T.: Also note: ticket #7892 about streaming timeout is likely unrelated but customer-facing. I've updated macros to include a polite notice and escalation steps.

Sam K.: Quick code review ping @Alex R. on PR #4021 (macro-change). Leaving comments about tests for batch_size boundary.

Alex R.: Thanks — pushed a tiny change to add unit test for batch boundaries. @Sam K. can you lgtm if green? CI is green locally.

OpsOncall: Incident bot: paging on-call for INC-4228 — 2 alerts suppressed. :rotating_light:

Kevin L.: I'll take on-call for this one. Starting investigation, ETA 30m.

Maria T.: For triage: today plan — keep current macros for 2 hours, monitor ticket velocity; if >45 tickets/hour escalate to on-call + customer success. Any objections?

Sam K.: No objections. I'll also PR a small observation to the macros repo to add a backlog tag so we can filter.

Alex R.: Great. I'll push a short note to the affected customers after Kevin has initial findings. Thanks team :thumbsup:
